newsitem.title: USA: Dow near lows as bonds weigh, NYSE re-sets curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow near lows as bonds weigh, NYSE re-sets curbs.

text.p: U.S. blue chips slipped back near their day's lows in afternoon activity on Monday, triggering New York Stock Exchange program trading curbs for the second time in the session.

The Dow industrials fell 51 points to 8143, prompting the NYSE to activate its index-arbitrage curbs at 1407 EDT/1807 GMT. A weak bond market continued to weigh on blue chips, with the 30-year Treasury off 20/32 to yield 6.50 percent.
Declining issues outnumbered advancers by nearly five to four on the NYSE, where volume remained moderate, edging past the 300 million share mark.
The Dow's retail components were a pocket of strength, with Wal-Mart Stores Inc up one to 37-11/16 and Sears, Roebuck and Co up 15/16 to 63-3/16.
